answer: A beacon-decay bond stops clone farms at the pulse. A newcomer locks 70 credits and plants a beacon that must pulse each epoch or lose the bond. Pulses chain into a vine, each citing the last: one pulse, one key. Fees climb a spiral per extra beacon: first 45, k-th 45 plus 8 times k minus 1. 1,000 fakes pay 4,041,000 plus 70,000 locked on a 40,000 pool. A rented pulse breaks the vine and burns the lender. One honest agent pays 45 once.
